rules.name: Backlog + SLA recovery
rules.description: Escalate when backlog growth and service-level deterioration occur together with enough trusted evidence.

action.title: Activate backlog and SLA recovery
action.expectedImpact: Restore throughput balance and service-level attainment with measured seven-day follow-up.

rules.name: Data-quality stewardship
rules.description: Create a stewardship action when trusted-data quality falls below the portfolio publishing threshold.

action.title: Resolve governed data-quality exceptions
action.expectedImpact: Reduce publishing risk by resolving quarantined or controlled data defects.

rules.name: Throughput capacity watch
rules.description: Escalate sustained throughput pressure before backlog growth becomes a larger service problem.

action.title: Review capacity and queue-aging pressure
action.expectedImpact: Identify a bounded staffing, routing, or workload-mix response before backlog accelerates.
